blocks.body:
I like coding. pushing ai coding, bro.

Working at **Goodput AI**, focusing on KVCache / Inference / MaaS. Hangzhou, China.

Care about: Efficiency Improvement, Automation, Standardization, Performance Testing, Performance Optimization, System Building, Storage / Caching, AI Infrastructure, Cluster, Cloud Native.

Looking for collaborators who are passionate about large scale inference optimization and distributed systems.

[GitHub](https://github.com/ActivePeter)

blocks.title: This world
blocks.body:
You are flying through a distributed voxel world written in Rust + Bevy, compiled to WebAssembly. On a server it runs as gateway + Region shards; here the terrain is generated in your browser.

WASD to fly, Space / Shift up and down, hold Ctrl to speed up.
